DecisionsDescription: What needs your decision. Everything is ticked: untick what you do not want, then approve.
NothingToDecide: Ahoy! Nothing needs a decision: the fleet is in good shape.
NoSourceConfigured: No source of findings is configured. Connect a Portarr, or point Orchestrarr at a sample file.
ShowingLastRead: Showing what was read at {time}. The last read failed: {error}
ApprovalNotAvailable: Approving is not available yet: no power is granted to Orchestrarr. This screen shows what it would propose.
NoAutomaticPlan: Nothing can be done automatically here: a person has to act.
FindingFailingCi: The CI of the default branch is failing
FindingDependencyScanUnavailable: Dependency alerts are off or cannot be read: this repository is not known to be clean
StepMergePullRequests: Merge the pull requests that pass
ReasonNoPlacement: The environment description does not say where this runs.
ErrorFailed: The source could not be read
ErrorUnauthorized: The source refused the credentials, or asks to sign in
ErrorTimeout: The source did not answer in time
ErrorInvalidResponse: The source answered with something unexpected
